title: Doc-truth lint: workflow refs and documented JSON paths validated by doctor
description: Extend doctor's workflow validation to resolve every workflows/ ref and every documented JSON extraction path in workflow/skill markdown against the live registry and envelope schemas, so the S1 class of doc drift cannot return.
acceptanceCriteria: doctor flags a workflow/skill doc referencing an unresolvable workflow ref or a JSON path absent from envelope schemas
Lint runs in CI via existing doctor strict path
